purpose: Detailed AI routing metadata for UNTOLD Wiki. Use ai-index.json first for normal requests. This file does not replace topical specification pages.

routingUsage.normal: AGENTS.md -> ai-index.json -> directly relevant canonical page(s)
routingUsage.currentState: AGENTS.md -> ai-current.json -> referenced current-state source -> canonical route for the candidate topic
routingUsage.governanceOrAudit: AGENTS.md -> pages/chatgpt-guide.md -> pages/governance/spec-maintenance.md and required registries

authorityOrder: newly confirmed decisions in the current conversation that are not yet committed
implementation status or implementation handoff summaries

statusSemantics.暫定: usable only as provisional specification and must be described as provisional
statusSemantics.未確定: not adopted; do not fill in by inference

routing.topic: wiki governance, specification maintenance, decision criteria, retroactive review, change impact
foreshadowing, hidden confirmed truths, intentionally unresolved story truths, meaningful dialogue subtext
routing.rule: Do not convert OPEN items into confirmed truths by inference. Intentional clues should be linked to a tracked target, and NONCLUE items must not be retrofitted into foreshadowing without an explicit design change.

routing.topic: information architecture, truth-question-information-observation-inference relationships, clue networks, NPC knowledge state, player inference stages
routing.rule: Use this page for the structure connecting truths, questions, information, observations, inferences and clues. Keep actual hidden truths and adopted clues canonical in foreshadowing-ledger, and keep player recording mechanics canonical in recording.md.

world setting, Orba, islands, world structure
terrain, terrain ids, town coordinates, passability
rivers, lakes, roads, bridges, mountain crossings
Eld city, layout, npcs, npc movement, protagonist home
game master personality, dialogue, first message
crafting, recipes, implementation-wide gameplay details without a dedicated page
routing.rule: If a dedicated topical page also covers the same fact, the dedicated topical page wins.

routing.topic: opening sequence and early Eld progression
routing.rule: The mandatory introduction spans multiple canonical pages. Follow later-page replacement notes and forward references through Day 2 formal quest registration before identifying the next design boundary.

routing.topic: current milestone and what to decide next
routing.rule: Do not infer an unresolved design decision from implementation-status or missing game code. Use open-items as a candidate list, then route the candidate topic through ai-index.json and verify its canonical page. For the current early-game flow, also follow the sources listed in ai-current.json to the last confirmed handoff.

The status page is progress documentation, not a game-design source of truth. Unimplemented, unconnected, or missing code does not mean the specification is undecided. Verify topical canonical pages separately when specification status matters, and verify the game repository when current implementation matters.

An item listed here can be stale; if a topical canonical page already marks it confirmed, the topical page wins and open-items should be cleaned up. Absence from open-items is not by itself proof of confirmation; use the topical canonical page.

updateRules.confirmedDecision: Write it to the topic-specific canonical page. Also review open-items, indexes, aliases and related references.
updateRules.singleSource: Keep one canonical source per specification fact. Prefer links or routing references over duplicated confirmed summaries in management pages.
updateRules.fastRoutingCache: Update ai-index.json when routing or high-value section hints change. Update ai-current.json only when current milestone or its primary navigation pointers change.
updateRules.crossCuttingCriterion: Register or revise the criterion in governance/criteria-registry.json with a stable id, scope, retroactiveMode and revision.
updateRules.retroactiveCriterion: When an added or changed criterion is applied or reviewed against existing content, record the affected, changed and exception paths in governance/review-ledger.json.
updateRules.existingPageBodyChange: Update the Markdown source only; do not synchronize wiki.json.
updateRules.legacyMaterial: Keep it clearly marked as legacy/history and never silently promote it to current specification.
updateRules.batching: As a normal conversation workflow, batch GitHub specification updates after roughly 10 confirmed items, or earlier at a topic boundary, conversation end, or explicit update request.
updateRules.implementationState: When the user asks what is actually implemented now, verify fg79sw4nvw-dot/untold-game when needed. Never convert implementation gaps into unresolved design decisions without checking the topical canonical source.
updateRules.resumeNextStep: For development resume or next-decision requests, use ai-current.json for navigation, route each candidate through ai-index.json, follow linked continuation pages to the last confirmed handoff, then propose only the first genuinely unresolved boundary.
